chapter: Silvers, Rampart Street and Army service
title: Parents, segregation, the bank dispute and WWL
summary: He talks about his father's many children, segregation limiting his parents, a bank he took his money from, an honorary doctorate and being turned down at WWL.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
